themes: Null-detector pattern: multiple quality gates (bidi coherence presentation-forms check, garble-gate Latin-gibberish blind spot, digit-ratio floor below 500 chars) structurally cannot fire on their real failure mode — the signal they test for is destroyed (NFKC decomposition) or excluded (line-selector range, char floor) before the check runs — yet their 'zero violations' measurement was historically read as evidence of safety and used to justify enabling stricter enforcement defaults (e.g., BIDI_COHERENCE_ENFORCE=true).

Threshold/config tightening repeatedly masquerades as content regression in corpus audits: Run-20's D4 pre-publish live-store re-verification found that reported 'structural collapses' (505->80 nodes) were in fact unchanged trees whose verdict flipped purely because a config-layering refactor (610d078) silently raised depth-adequacy or char-floor thresholds — underscoring that live-store verification against actual MinIO state, not just dispatched figures, is required before attributing a verdict change to extraction damage.

Fix-one-instance-miss-the-other duplication is a chronic, cross-cutting defect generator: the garble digit-ratio floor was duplicated between _tree_is_garbled/_flat_text_is_garbled (ISS-36) and again between garble_prongs and _garble_check_nodes' fallback (RFC-040 2a); verdict priority maps were duplicated (_LEDGER_VERDICT_PRIORITY vs _LEDGER_PRIORITY, RFC-037); dual verdict-arbitration CAS guards used inconsistent comparison operators (> vs >=, RFC-037). Each recurrence independently produced a defect zone.

Partial RFC implementation is actively net-negative across consecutive remediation waves: POST-FIX-WAVE3 shows 4 of 7 zones REGRESSED (net +14 bugs) precisely because proposed fixes were applied incompletely — new code paths (source_selection=True bypassing _apply_clamp; config.garble_short_text_default hard override) were introduced alongside old bypasses (_has_image_rescue) that were never removed, compounding rather than resolving the underlying cascade. The scorecard explicitly recommends halting further zone-by-zone fixes pending a clean re-audit baseline.

Remote/external-service code drift is a repeated generative mechanism: the same 'no version/contract check on an externally deployed service' root cause independently produces the BiDi F1 stale-Docling-microservice heading-reversal defect and the Converter-Chain-Fallback zone's inability to distinguish a legitimate remote outage from AGPL-fallback-worthy structural failure — both flagged as needing a /version endpoint or build-provenance check that has not landed in either case.

HR2 (erasure) and HR3 (PII/ZDR egress) compliance gaps recur every time a new storage location or new egress call site is added, because there is no single canonical, auto-discovering cascade/gate list: the original ISS-02/ISS-41 erasure gaps (preloaded/, registry fire-and-forget) reappear structurally identical in RFC-037's verdicts/{sha256}.json gap; the RFC-011 boot-time HR3 gate covers only the server process while all real document egress happens in the unchecked worker process and two Docling remote-conversion call sites.

Verdict/garble/OCR-recovery form a tightly coupled triad where a fix to one leg reliably flips outcomes on the other two: closing the tessdata Latin-substitution garble blind spot (RFC-040 D5) directly caused verdict ERRORs (MOU MOHRE, pie-chart) that are OCR-recovery failures in disguise; the GATE_TABLE reason-masking defect sits exactly at the verdict<->OCR-recovery boundary and was never independently fixed, only relabeled across zone reorganizations — reflecting the historical PASS_MAX_LEAF_RATIO threshold oscillation (0.17->0.20->0.30) that motivated RFC-037's ledger/hysteresis removal in the first place.

Compensating heuristics are repeatedly substituted for the actual proposed fix, then themselves become new defect sources: the Bidi/RTL zone 'stalled' with only a workaround heuristic (assume presentation forms survive when none do) instead of the proposed NFKC reorder; the OCR Recovery zone's kill-switch split was never implemented but a NEW string-matching fragility appeared in its place — each wave trades a known, documented gap for a fresh, undocumented one.

Audit/measurement tooling shares the same blind spots as the code it audits: table-role blocks' by-design absence of a 'text' key causes both the production content-scoring path and the audit's own char-count diagnostics (plus the proposed RFC-022 B1-Fix synthetic-structure builder) to independently undercount content — meaning a fix applied only to production code, without also fixing the audit harness, leaves the harness capable of re-reporting the same false regression on the next run.
